Description: MENYO-20k presents the first multi-domain parallel corpus for Yorùbá-English machine translation with standardized train-test splits and clean orthography. The study demonstrates significant improvements (+8.7 BLEU over Google, +9.1 BLEU over Facebook M2M) when translating to Yorùbá, establishing high-quality benchmarks for African language machine translation.
